_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Your story in numbers is ready

description: Use this when the user wants to know how many days they have been together, an "our story in numbers" or relationship stats poster, an anniversary gift printable, a days-together counter, or the date of a milestone such as "when is our 1,000th day", "our 100th day" or "500 weeks together". Pass start_date (first date, the day they met, wedding day) and, when given, start_time, time_zone, names and occasion (together, married, engaged, friends, family). Returns the days, weeks, months, years, hours, full moons, weekends, leap days and anniversaries, the next round milestones with dates, a printable poster PDF (Letter, A4, A3, 12x18 in) and an ICS file with those milestones. Does not invent dates: ask for the start date if it is missing. Does not accept future start dates or dates before 1900. Not for countdowns to a future event or for age calculations of a single person.

as_of.description: Optional date to count to, e.g. "2026-12-25" for a gift given that day. Default: today.

count_first_day.description: true to count the first day as day 1 (Korean couple style: the 100th day is start + 99 days). Default false: days elapsed, the 1,000-day mark is start + 1,000 days.

date_order.description: Optional order for dates like 03/04/2019: "mdy" (US, default) or "dmy".

milestones.description: How many upcoming milestones to list and put in the calendar file, 1 to 20. Default 8.

names.description: Optional names printed as the poster headline, e.g. "Alex & Sam".

occasion.description: together (default), married, engaged, friends or family. Sets the wording, e.g. "1,000 days married".

reminder_days_before.description: Days before each milestone for the calendar reminder (at 09:00), 0 to 60. Default 7.

start_date.description: The day the story began (first date, the day you met, wedding day), e.g. "2019-06-14" or "June 14, 2019". Must not be in the future.

start_time.description: Optional time of day it began, e.g. "19:30" or "7:30 pm". Used for the hours count; default midnight.

theme.description: Colour theme: blush (default), ivory, sage or midnight.

time_zone.description: Optional IANA time zone where it began, e.g. "America/Chicago" or "Europe/London". Makes hours count clock changes and dates full moons locally; also sets "today". Default: America/New_York for today, UTC for full moon dates.

title.description: Optional small heading, e.g. "Our story in numbers" (default) or "Five years of us".

name: generate_anniversary_poster
title: Generate anniversary poster
